title: Workflow & Code Hygiene
description: Catches stale debug noise, todo-rot, and other anti-patterns that signal sloppy completion.

rules.message: console.log left in code — keep logger.* in daemon and toast errors in panel; debug logs should be removed.
rules.remediation: Replace with logger.debug / logger.info (daemon) or remove. Use console.error only in catch blocks.

rules.message: TODO/FIXME marker — track in a real issue or remove. Stale TODOs are noise.
rules.remediation: Either fix now, or remove the marker and write it in CHANGELOG / docs/wiki as an explicit open gap.

rules.message: `debugger` statement left in code — halts the renderer in DevTools.
rules.remediation: Remove before commit. If you need a breakpoint, use VS Code's DAP.

rules.message: `as any` cast — usually a sign that types weren't modeled correctly.
rules.remediation: Define the proper interface or use `unknown` + type guard. Only middleware coercion (`protectCentralAPI as any`) is whitelisted.

rules.message: Empty catch block — silent failure hides bugs.
rules.remediation: At minimum: logger.warn / console.error the error. Or document why it's intentionally ignored.
